newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound averages 3.3919/3.3951 to dlr.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound averages 3.3919/3.3951 to dlr.

text.p: Private-sector Egyptian banks said the dollar ranged from 3.3910 to 3.3940 bid and 3.3935 to 3.3960 offer in the interbank market on Monday.
One banker said he dealt at 3.3900 and 3.3905 bid but others gave higher rates.
A survey of four actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3919 pounds bid and 3.3951 offered. The averages compared to of 3.3933 pounds bid and 3.3960 offered on Sunday.
Bankers said there was little demand for dollars and some said next week's Eid al-Adha holiday was keeping many investors out of the market.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday (1000 GMT) as 3.392682 buy and 3.398030 sell.
